nodes.label: A14 · Feature-enrichment ablation (Rung-3 GBM only)
nodes.rationale: Scope note leads the file because the verdict binds only the Rung-3 GBM and was repeatedly misread as a ruling on the exogenous set in general or on the served model.

nodes.label: Rung-3 GBM (baseline MASE 0.9551, 90% coverage 87.9%)
nodes.rationale: The only ladder model that consumes engineered features, which is why it is the only model this ablation can judge.

nodes.label: rung4_chronos2_exo — served Beer Hall model (rolling MASE 0.745)
nodes.rationale: Reaches covariates by a different mechanism (zero-shot conditioning through context/future frames) rather than engineered columns, so the GBM's negative verdict does not transfer; it carries weather live and earned its rung at the same gate.

nodes.label: CHRONOS2_EXO_COLS — 15-column known-future exogenous set
nodes.rationale: 4 calendar + 1 event + 6 World Cup + 4 weather columns; widened from four calendar flags at G12.10b, after this ablation was written.

nodes.label: 90% model confidence set adoption rule (39 disjoint folds)
nodes.rationale: A column ships only if the 90% MCS EXCLUDES the baseline and retains the candidate, and coverage does not degrade by >3pp. Replaces the old >1% six-fold mean cut, which sat well inside fold-to-fold noise (ledger M24). The origin advances by a full horizon over the whole span because six folds is fewer than the moving-block length, which makes every bootstrap resample identical to the sample and pins every MCS p-value to 0 or 1.

nodes.label: Constant-0 event feature in test folds (honest null, not a bug)
nodes.rationale: Only 7 local-event days fall in the active window and none in the recent rolling-origin test folds, so the event feature cannot change test MASE by construction; recorded as an honest null rather than a defect.

nodes.label: Weather train/serve consistency study (§4)
nodes.rationale: Named as the methodological contribution of the enrichment work: at inference only a forecast of weather is known, so the question is which TRAINING basis predicts best when SERVING on a forecast basis. Observed (ERA5) is an upper bound only, and the oracle (0.9005) is explicitly not achievable live.

nodes.label: leadmatched weather basis (forecast as issued 3 days ahead)
nodes.rationale: Serving basis for the study. Forecast skill at 3-day lead: temperature MAE 0.86 C (basis barely matters), precipitation MAE 3.55 mm (rain is where basis choice matters most).

nodes.label: Three training bases not separable on 39 folds
nodes.rationale: The 90% MCS retains observed, hindcast and leadmatched, so the lowest mean is marked as a ranking and 'best' is deliberately not written next to it.

nodes.label: Honest negative verdict — no exogenous feature adopted into the GBM
nodes.rationale: Against a strong autoregressive baseline (lag-7/14, roll-28, DOW) every candidate increases held-out MASE: calendar flags are near-constant inside the test folds so they only add a spurious split, weather overfits ~270 training days, curated events have no test-fold anchor. Adoption is gated by evidence, and the enrichment's retained value is (1) a populated seam for deviation/change-point attribution and (2) the train/serve study itself (FLAG-FE1..FE10).
